purpose: Diagnostic-only audit descriptor for arterial-load morphology during AoV/PV-open ejection, including ejection squareness, top curvature, corner sharpness, and AoP/PAP incisura attribution.

auditScope.limbDefinition: Samples with semilunar valve open and AV valve closed, split into opening corner, core ejection, peak/top region, closing corner, and event-adjacent transition windows.
primaryQuestions: Are AoV/PV-open ejection limbs excessively square or flat-topped?
Are top curvature and corner sharpness dominated by event windows or present in core ejection?
Are AoP/PAP incisura/dicrotic-notch features present, absent, inverted, or artifact-correlated?
Do findings align with Zc, reflection, root compliance, semilunar valve, active-stress, or qDot evidence?

arterialLoadAndArtifact.name: characteristicImpedancePaSecPerM3
arterialLoadAndArtifact.description: Not explicitly modeled by the current runtime; do not infer from resistance, inertance, compliance, pressure, or flow.

arterialLoadAndArtifact.name: arterialReflectionCoefficient
arterialLoadAndArtifact.description: Not explicitly modeled by the current runtime; do not infer from pressure or flow shape.

arterialLoadAndArtifact.name: arterialReflectionDelaySec
arterialLoadAndArtifact.description: No explicit reflection path/delay is modeled by the current runtime.

semilunarOpenEjectionSquareness.description: Flat-sided or rectangular quality of the AoV/PV-open ejection PV limb, reported separately for LV/AoV and RV/PV under both transition policies.

aovOpenEjectionSquareness.description: LV/AoV-specific alias of semilunarOpenEjectionSquareness for handoff traceability.

pvOpenEjectionSquareness.description: RV/PV-specific alias of semilunarOpenEjectionSquareness for handoff traceability.

ejectionTopCurvature.description: Curvature-like metric over the pressure-volume top region near peak ventricular pressure during ejection.

ejectionCornerSharpness.description: Robust slope/curvature discontinuity score near semilunar opening and closing corners.

ejectionPlateauFraction.description: Fraction of ejection samples with near-flat pressure top after robust scale normalization.

ejectionLimbKinkCount.description: Count of slope/curvature outliers on the semilunar-open ejection limb.

arterialPressureIncisuraDepth.description: AoP/PAP dicrotic notch or incisura depth relative to local pre/post-closing shoulder.

arterialPressureIncisuraTimingSec.description: Timing of incisura relative to semilunar valve close event or inferred close transition.

incisuraPresenceScore.description: Robust score for present, absent, inverted, or artifact-dominated AoP/PAP incisura morphology.

aovOpenAoPIncisuraScore.description: LV/AoV/AoP-specific incisura score for handoff traceability.

pvOpenPAPIncisuraScore.description: RV/PV/PAP-specific incisura score for handoff traceability.

arterialPressureTopCurvature.description: Curvature-like metric over systolic AoP/PAP top pressure.

ventricularArterialGradientProfile.description: Time-normalized LVP-AoP or RVP-PAP gradient profile across ejection.

peakPressureTimingAsFractionOfEjection.description: Timing of peak ventricular or proximal arterial pressure as a fraction of the ejection window.

zcCouplingScore.description: Association between ejection sharpness/incisura features and characteristic impedance evidence when available.

reflectionCouplingScore.description: Association between waveform shoulder/incisura features and reflection coefficient or delay evidence when available.

rootComplianceCouplingScore.description: Association between top curvature, incisura damping, and aortic/pulmonary root compliance evidence when available.

semilunarValveEventCoincidenceFraction.description: Fraction of ejection-limb outliers inside semilunar open/close event windows or valve-state residual outliers.

activeStressCouplingScore.description: Association between ejection PV morphology residuals and active stress or active-stress derivative evidence when available.

qDotCoincidenceFraction.description: Fraction of ejection-limb or incisura outliers aligned with qDot spikes or qDot clamp activation.

samplingOnlyScore.description: Magnitude of apparent morphology improvement or classification change across sampling modes without matching raw event evidence.

aoPulmonaryAsymmetryIndex.description: Absolute LV/AoV/aortic versus RV/PV/pulmonary difference for paired ejection morphology metrics, normalized by paired mean plus epsilon.

arterial-load-morphology-finding.description: Ejection or arterial-pressure morphology finding is present.

aov-open-ejection.description: Finding is on the LV/AoV open ejection limb.

pv-open-ejection.description: Finding is on the RV/PV open ejection limb.

excessive-squareness.description: Ejection limb is unusually rectangular or flat-sided under the configured metric.

flat-top-curvature.description: Top curvature indicates a flat or plateau-like pressure-volume top.

sharp-corner.description: Opening or closing corner sharpness is high relative to robust scale.

incisura-present.description: AoP/PAP incisura is present under the configured score.

incisura-absent.description: AoP/PAP incisura is absent or overly damped under the configured score.

incisura-inverted.description: AoP/PAP notch direction is inverted or physiologically suspicious under the configured score.

flat-aop-during-ejection.description: AoP is flat or plateau-like during LV/AoV ejection.

flat-pap-during-ejection.description: PAP is flat or plateau-like during RV/PV ejection.

aop-lacks-incisura.description: AoP lacks an incisura near AoV closure under raw-pressure evidence.

pap-lacks-incisura.description: PAP lacks an incisura near PV closure under raw-pressure evidence.

valve-transition-corner.description: Corner sharpness aligns primarily with semilunar valve transition timing.

active-stress-plateau.description: Ejection morphology aligns with a flat or plateau-like active-stress waveform.

afterload-too-compliant.description: Finding is consistent with excessive proximal/downstream arterial compliance evidence.

z-candidate-deficit.description: Finding is consistent with missing or inadequate characteristic impedance evidence.

zc-correlated.description: Finding aligns with characteristic impedance evidence.

reflection-correlated.description: Finding aligns with reflection coefficient or delay evidence.

root-compliance-correlated.description: Finding aligns with aortic/pulmonary root compliance evidence.

semilunar-valve-correlated.description: Finding aligns with semilunar valve event timing, valve state, or valve residual evidence.

active-stress-correlated.description: Finding aligns with active stress or active-stress derivative evidence.

qdot-correlated.description: Finding aligns with qDot spike or clamp evidence.

sampling-only.description: Finding changes materially under resampling without matching raw event evidence.

transition-dominated.description: Finding is materially reduced or disappears when transition samples are excluded.

unclassified.description: Available evidence is insufficient or mixed.

raw.description: Primary report from emitted samples without smoothing or interpolation.

uniformBeatGrid.description: Beat-normalized uniform resampling used to detect derivative sensitivity; interpolation type must be recorded.

eventAlignedCore.description: Semilunar-open ejection core with configured transition windows excluded.

coarseSensitivity.description: Coarser grid sensitivity report used to flag sampling-only morphology.

guardrails.rule: Do not change model equations, solver behavior, official case parameters, UI smoothing, or package scripts to improve this report.
Compute and preserve raw-sample ejection and arterial-pressure metrics before any resampling sensitivity report.
Do not smooth ventricular pressure, arterial pressure, volume, flow, qDot, or valve state before primary metrics.
Report ejection and arterial-pressure metrics with transition samples included and excluded.
Do not infer a present incisura from smoothed or resampled data when raw AoP/PAP evidence is absent.
LV/AoV/aortic and RV/PV/pulmonary paths must use identical metric formulas and sampling modes.
Each non-unclassified label must cite the signal and score that caused it; missing optional signals must be recorded as unavailable.
This audit reports diagnostic classifications only and does not create official morphology pass/fail criteria.

antiGamingGuards: Do not change official case parameters, arterial resistance/compliance/Zc/reflection values, valve thresholds, qDot clamp policy, active stress, or solver settings to improve morphology metrics.
Do not hide ejection squareness or missing incisura by UI-only smoothing, display decimation, or resampled-only reporting.
Do not classify a missing incisura as physiologic without raw AoP/PAP and semilunar-close evidence.
Do not report only transition-excluded metrics; transition-inclusive results are mandatory.
Do not compare aortic and pulmonary paths with different derivative stencils, beat windows, or normalization constants.
candidateFixFailureModes: squareness improves but SV, CO, or stroke work collapses
incisura appears only with nonphysiologic reverse flow
morphology improves while qDot, valve diode, or dynamic flow clamp events increase
